reply:
Open [Mending Table](./index.html) in a regular Chrome window on the café laptop. It works offline without installation.

Volunteers can enter up to three garments per visitor. Saving an intake assigns each garment a ticket number and shows which number to write on each tag. Volunteers can search by number, garment, or repair request, then change or correct an item’s status. The form asks only for garment and repair details.

Saved tickets use the browser’s local database. Keep using the same browser profile and file location between sessions. The [volunteer guide](./README.md) covers intake, pickup, and storage.

I checked ticket assignment, search, status correction, failed-save recovery, and reload behavior using simulated browser storage. The sandbox blocked a full browser launch, so persistence in Chrome remains unverified here.
